name: Paranoid
blurb: Sees the player's hand in every misfortune; counts exits; trusts no kindness.

name: Hoarding
blurb: Stockpiles food, nails, candles — anything. Refuses to part with stock at any price.

name: Clingy
blurb: Attaches desperately to the player; follows, pleads, cannot bear to be left.

name: Despondent
blurb: Has stopped pretending tomorrow is different. Speaks in past tense about living people.

name: Mute
blurb: Stopped speaking entirely. Communicates in nods, or not at all.

name: Violent
blurb: The fear has curdled. Lashes out at slights real or imagined, even in the square.

name: Fanatic
blurb: Believes the loop is judgment and someone must be offered up to end it.

name: Prophetic
blurb: Sees too much at the edges. Says true things nobody wants explained.
